title: ReStreet v1.1 is out + ONLINE OPEN BETA for FIFA Street (2012) on PC (native recompilation)
author: Lucky-Concentrate798
selftext:
Hi everyone! ReStreet, the native PC port of \*\*FIFA Street (2012)\*\*, has a new release and the \*\*online beta is now open to everyone\*\*.



\## ReStreet v1.1 (offline)

\- New \*\*ReStreet logo\*\* on the main menu and Press Start screen

\- Better \*\*"Some" graphics mode\*\*, now the default: less glitches on floors and reflections, same speed

\- \*\*VSync fixed\*\*: smooth and locked to your refresh rate, no tearing

\- \*\*Direct play\*\*: start the game without the launcher (new Shortcut button)

\- Setup and launcher fit any screen and Windows scale



You need your own FIFA Street (2012) Xbox 360 ISO. The ISO and game files are not included.



👉 \*\*Download (GitHub release):\*\* [https://github.com/samuelit0davila/fifa-street-pc-port/releases/tag/v1.1](https://github.com/samuelit0davila/fifa-street-pc-port/releases/tag/v1.1)

To update, run the new \`FifaStreetSetup.exe\` and pick your existing folder. No ISO needed, your saves are kept.



\## Online open beta

Play against other people over the internet. No sign-up: install v1.1, then the online patch on top of it.



1. Install \*\*ReStreet v1.1\*\* (link above)

2. Download the \*\*online patch\*\*: [https://limewire.com/d/fMF3M#JiH2RHz4oR](https://limewire.com/d/fMF3M#JiH2RHz4oR)

   SHA-256: \`bb31bfd010808a9cf44b6d7cfd844adf4ad87ecf6403d515ffbd617b9c97825c\`

3. Run the patch, pick your game folder and a player name, open the launcher and press PLAY

4. In the game: \*\*Xbox LIVE → Street Seasons → Division Match\*\*, pick a mode and search



The launcher has a \*\*LOBBY\*\* button that shows who is online (🟢), who is searching for a match and in which mode (🟡) and who is in a match (🔵). You can also see it in a browser: [http://57.129.180.15:29812/lobby](http://57.129.180.15:29812/lobby)



\*\*What works:\*\* 1v1 matchmaking, play with friends (invites), up to 64 players online at once.

\*\*What doesn't work yet:\*\* leaderboards, the Cup clock, season tables, teams of 3 or more.



\*\*Please note:\*\*

\- This is a beta: expect bugs, and the server is a single small VPS in Europe, so ping depends on where you live.

\- Your opponent's game connects to yours directly (or through our relay), so they may see your IP address. The lobby only shows your player name.

\- Online only works with the v1.1 build from the release above.



It's a quiet game at the moment, so the best way to find a match is to \*\*coordinate in our Discord\*\*: [https://discord.gg/CqjYMGKyy2](https://discord.gg/CqjYMGKyy2)



Feedback is very welcome: tell me your country, your connection and how the match felt, and send the \`fifastreet.log\` if something breaks (launcher → Open logs).
